title: For Loop Basics
description: Use a for loop to print each item in a short list.

starter_files.content:
colors = ["red", "blue", "green"]
# Print each color using a for loop

learning_objectives: Use a for loop to repeat work for each item.
Print each item from a list on its own line.
hints: A for loop can visit each value in colors.
Put print inside the loop body.
